method.full_resolution_review: All six clean frozen 1080x1080 master PNGs were inspected at original resolution.
method.standard_preview_review: The six clean candidates were compared in one 3x2 contact sheet after direct 360x360 Lanczos downsampling.
method.stress_preview_review: Each master was downsampled directly to 120x120 with Lanczos. The six thumbnails were enlarged 3x with nearest-neighbor only for pixel-preserving side-by-side inspection.
limitations: This is an unblinded local visual selection prior, not a formal content-result critic pass.
The 120-pixel derivative is a stress test, not a model of an Instagram delivery transform.
No delivery, click, conversion, revenue, recall, or externally controlled competition evidence exists.
The exact server element UUIDs required by the formal critic contract are absent and were not fabricated.

observations.at_120: The empty salon chair, loss headline, offer surface, and CTA remain distinguishable.
observations.strength: Most concrete lost-customer moment and strongest immediate salon context.
observations.tradeoff: The dark negative scene and longer headline consume more attention than the short-hook alternatives.

observations.at_120: The main headline, oversized 90-day offer, CTA, and three-state silhouette survive.
observations.strength: Clearest promotional hierarchy and fastest offer recognition.
observations.tradeoff: The creative supplies less category imagery and less concrete return behavior than A, G, or H.

observations.at_120: The headline, cyan Risk stage, offer, and CTA survive while tertiary route detail recedes.
observations.tradeoff: Its value depends more on deliberate reading than the short-hook or object-led candidates.

observations.at_120: The Risk card, outcome headline, offer, CTA, and brand mark survive; proof detail becomes secondary.
observations.strength: Most explicit exact-canonical decision-state proof without pretending to be product UI.
observations.tradeoff: It has the greatest dependence on compact explanatory detail and the least emotional scene-setting.

observations.at_120: The calendar, cyan return loop, outcome headline, offer, and CTA remain distinguishable.
observations.strength: Strongest high-key physical metaphor and clearest object-level beauty/salon cues.
observations.tradeoff: The image-call origin and longer headline make it costlier and slightly slower to parse than H.

observations.at_120: The three-line contrast hook, selected cyan route, calendar silhouette, offer, CTA, and brand mark survive together.
observations.strength: Shortest distinctive hook, strongest dark-light split, current canonical provenance, positive text clearance, and no image-call cost.
observations.tradeoff: Its abstract network and calendar communicate less explicit salon context than the chair or physical still life.

decision.selection_prior_reason: Among the clean set, H combines the shortest hook with the strongest 120-pixel split silhouette, exact current provenance, positive placement gates, and protected offer/CTA. This is an action prior, not an outcome claim.
decision.next_action: Keep H as the primary local selection prior while preserving G, A, and B as orthogonal challengers. Reconcile outbound evidence without polling and activate human_story packet 005 only if authorized source-metadata-bearing real photography appears. Bind exact feedback to event ID and frozen digest before updating the prior.
